operations.name: 菲米尼
operations.action: e, wait(0.3), q, attack(0.2), e, wait(0.3), attack(0.2), e, wait(0.3), attack(0.2), e, wait(0.3), attack(0.2), e, wait(0.3)

note: 默认物理战技 C：E 进 Pers Timer，普攻叠压，Q 进 Subnautical Hunter（大剑强化，每次普攻 +2 压）并重置 E。标准物理循环约 EQ N2 [E N2 E N1]×2，N2 = attack(0.2)。关键：Q 后 E 的冷却由 10 秒降到 3 秒，所以要先 Q 才放得出连续 E。
